items.title: Thousands of 'Greater Serbia' supporters attend funeral of Ratko Mladic in Belgrade
items.description: The former commander of the Serbian army in Bosnia and Herzegovina, who was convicted by an international court for genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity during the conflicts in the former Yugoslavia in the 1990s and who died in prison in The Hague, was buried in the Serbian capital on Monday.

items.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia ignite fires at oil facilities and wound 73 people
items.description: The attacks come after weeks of escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen, which shattered a four-year truce in the country's civil war.

items.title: Yemeni forces launch counteroffensive against Houthis, vow to retake Sanaa
items.description: Bid to take the capital comes as clashes between Yemeni forces and Houthis intensify in the provinces of al-Bayda and al-Jawf.

items.description: Mladić was jailed for genocide during the 1990s Bosnian war and the EU warned Serbia not to glorify the convicted war criminal.

items.title: Human rights chief Türk renews call for end to spiralling Sudan war
items.description: The ongoing war in Sudan took centre stage at the UN Human Rights Council on Monday where the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, Volker Türk, led calls for an end to attacks on civilians in “markets, hospitals [and] fuel stations”.

items.title: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner hold Ukraine talks after meeting Putin
items.description: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv, seeking to revive efforts to end the war. But the latest diplomatic push seems to have produced no breakthrough.

items.title: Putin meets with US envoys for renewed talks on ending the war in Ukraine
items.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin met with U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to try to revive a push to end the Russia-Ukraine war.
